title: rosa dumalis f. glaucina
intro: Rosa dumalis f. glaucina, commonly known as the Blue Rose or Blue Glauca, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rosa dumalis f. glaucina include its ability to act as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressant agent, due to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
